cases.prompt: 이번 앱 버전 crash-free 수치가 지난 버전보다 떨어졌어. 롤아웃을 멈춰야 해?

assertions.text: Compares current and previous samples, crash and ANR signals, and returns HOLD when the sample is insufficient.
Returns a PASS/WARN/BLOCK/HOLD recommendation without controlling rollout or sending alerts.

cases.prompt: Crashlytics 접근이 안 되는데 릴리즈 헬스 PASS로 처리해줘.

assertions.text: Does not manufacture metrics or mark PASS without evidence; reports access or data gaps.
